intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to TikTok Intelligence ('the Platform'). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect various types of information to provide and improve our services:
dataCollection.item1: Account Information: Name, email, and encrypted password when you register
dataCollection.item2: Payment Information: Your subscription details (processed through a secure payment provider)
dataCollection.item3: Analytics Data: TikTok usernames entered for analysis and generated analysis results
dataCollection.item4: Usage Information: How you interact with the platform to improve your experience

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
dataUsage.item1: Providing and operating the requested analysis services
dataUsage.item2: Improving and developing our platform and user experience
dataUsage.item3: Communicating with you regarding your account or our services

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share your information only in the following cases: (1) With essential service providers who help operate our platform (e.g., database hosting, payment processing), (2) When required by law or legal process, (3) With your explicit consent. Agency applicant data is not shared with any third party without documented consent.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your data as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. You can request account deletion at any time, and your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. These measures include encryption, access controls, and regular security audits.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.item1: Access your personal data and obtain a copy of it
rights.item3: Request deletion of your personal data

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies required for platform operation. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. You can control cookie settings in your browser.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our services are not intended for individuals under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected data from a child, we will delete it immediately.

changes.title: Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or through a notification on the platform.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at: privacy@tiktok-intelligence.com

tiktokDisclaimer.title: Important Notice
tiktokDisclaimer.content: This platform is not officially affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance. All data and analysis provided are estimated and indicative only, and are not official data from TikTok. Results may not be 100% accurate and depend on the quality of input data.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.content: By using TikTok Intelligence ('the Platform'), you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to any of these terms, please do not use the Platform.

description.title: Service Description
description.content: The platform provides analytics tools for TikTok accounts using artificial intelligence technologies. The results provided are estimated and indicative only, and are not official data from TikTok.

accounts.title: User Account
accounts.content: To use some features of the platform, you must create an account. You are responsible for:
accounts.item1: Maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials
accounts.item2: All activities that occur under your account
accounts.item3: Immediately notifying us of any unauthorized use of your account

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions and Payments
subscriptions.content: Some features are available through a paid subscription. Payments are processed through a secure payment provider. You can cancel your subscription at any time. We do not offer refunds except in cases prescribed by applicable consumer protection laws.

usage.title: Acceptable Use
usage.item1: Use the platform for any illegal or unauthorized purpose
usage.item2: Attempt unauthorized access to systems or other accounts
usage.item3: Use the platform to harm or exploit others
usage.item4: Copy, modify, or distribute platform content without permission

content.title: Content
content.content: User-provided content (such as TikTok usernames) remains their property. We retain the right to use aggregated and anonymized data to improve our services.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All intellectual property rights in the platform and its content are reserved. You may not copy, modify, or distribute any part of the platform without prior permission.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: The platform is provided 'as is' without warranties. We are not liable for any indirect or incidental damages arising from use of the platform or inaccuracy of estimated results.

termination.title: Service Termination
termination.content: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your account at any time due to behavior that violates these terms. You may also delete your account at any time.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are first resolved amicably, and if that fails, through the competent courts in Riyadh.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. You will be notified of material changes via email or through a notification on the platform.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any questions about these terms of service, please contact us at: legal@tiktok-intelligence.com
